description: Search Chewy.com by keyword, browse category, brand or listing URLs, or look up specific products. Every field below is used by the actor.

autoshipOnly.description: Only return products that offer Chewy Autoship.
autoshipOnly.title: Autoship eligible only

brandName.description: Brand to scrape (mode=byBrand). Example: `Royal Canin`, `Blue Buffalo`.
brandName.title: Brand name (mode=byBrand)

brandNames.description: Several brands to scrape in one run (mode=byBrand).
brandNames.title: Brand names (mode=byBrand)

categoryUrls.description: Several Chewy category URLs to browse in one run (mode=byCategory).
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs (mode=byCategory)

dealOnly.description: Only return products Chewy marks as a current deal.
dealOnly.title: Deals only

enrichDetails.description: Fetch each product's detail page to add variants, ingredients, attributes and packaging. Slower but richer output; off by default.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich with product details

excludeKeywords.description: Skip products whose name contains any of these words (case-insensitive).
excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords

excludeProductIds.description: Skip these product ids or SKUs.
excludeProductIds.title: Exclude product ids

inStockOnly.description: Only return products currently in stock.
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

listingUrls.description: Any Chewy search, category, brand or deals URL (mode=byListingUrls). Product URLs are also accepted and treated as product lookups.
listingUrls.title: Listing URLs (mode=byListingUrls)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Only return products priced at or below this value.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price ($)

minPrice.description: Only return products priced at or above this value.
minPrice.title: Minimum price ($)

minRating.description: Only return products rated at or above this value (0.0–5.0).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: How to find products. `search` for keyword search, `byCategory` for category URLs, `byBrand` for a brand name, `byProductUrls` for product page URLs, `byProductIds` for bare Chewy product ids, and `byListingUrls` for any Chewy listing/search URL.
mode.title: Mode

newOnly.description: Only return products Chewy marks as new.
newOnly.title: New products only

petType.description: Only return products for this pet type. Applied server-side when Chewy exposes a pet facet and verified from product detail pages otherwise.
petType.title: Pet type filter

productIds.description: Bare Chewy product ids (the number after /dp/) or product URLs (mode=byProductIds).
productIds.title: Product ids (mode=byProductIds)

searchQueries.description: Run several keyword searches in one go (mode=search). When filled, these run in addition to `searchQuery`.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

searchQuery.description: Keyword search query (mode=search). Example: `dog food`, `cat toys`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Result order for search, category, brand and listing modes.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: Chewy product page URLs to enrich (mode=byProductUrls). Example: `https://www.chewy.com/royal-canin-adult-dry-dog-food/dp/123456`.
startUrls.title: Product URLs (mode=byProductUrls)

title: Chewy Product Scraper Input
